risks.title: Cyberattack or IT system failure
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned at the top of risk factors with a dedicated governance process (Cyber Risk Committee) and oversight by the Audit Committee. Language emphasizes material risk to operations. Enhanced governance indicates high priority, but the absence of reported major incidents provides some mitigation.

risks.title: Exposure to macroeconomic risks
risks.score_rationale: The 10-K cites economic uncertainty, persistent inflation, interest rates, and geopolitical conflicts as factors that could negatively impact the company. While 2025 impact is deemed limited, the tone indicates heightened vigilance and possible future exposure, reinforcing severity.

risks.title: Lease renewal risk
risks.score_rationale: 13.1% of rental revenues are set to expire in 2026, with renewal schedule extending through 2030. Risk is amplified by dependence on rents as primary revenue source. Language indicates active management but highlights vulnerability in case of declining tenant demand.

risks.title: Real estate development risk
risks.score_rationale: Development program (3.5M square feet, 18.8% leased) represents significant future investment ($161M remaining to deploy). Document mentions mitigation measures (land cap, rent adjustments), but risk of overcapacity or underleasing persists.

risks.title: Dependence on financing conditions
risks.score_rationale: Company relies on capital markets for refinancing (bank credit, equity issuance, debt). While Moody's rating is positive, any deterioration in credit conditions could limit access to capital needed for development and acquisitions.

risks.title: Non-material but unpredictable litigation
risks.score_rationale: Document indicates no major litigation is pending, but acknowledges that lawsuits could arise and have material impact if unfavorable. Language minimizes current risk but admits uncertainty, typical of standard disclosure.

ai_positioning.summary: EastGroup does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 2025 annual report.
